title: Friday Prayers: Becoming an individual whom Prophet Muhammad s.a.w. is proud of
description: Friday khutbah in Malay with English subtitles.

sources.caption:
Assalamualaikum Wr. Wb dear blessed congregants!

Insyaallah, this is our Khatib & Bilal for our Friday Prayers, 28 Aug 2026 (15 Rabiulawal 1448H)!

May Allah accept our worship and grant us His blessings on this sacred day.

—————————

Seize the opportunity and barakah on Fridays by donating to the mosque!
You may do so via these methods:
1- PayNow : UEN T06MQ0029K
2- Donation Portal : donate.annahdhah.org
3- Bank Transfer : OCBC current Acc 501-885628-001
4- Mosque Office Counter Level 1

Thank you for your contributions!
May Allah s.w.t grant you and your family blessing and reward in this world and the hereafter! Amin.
